title: Timepoint 3 — Unexpected recovery after antibiotics stopped
scenarioBrief: Now we jump ahead about ten days. After the family meeting, comfort-focused care was begun — and unexpectedly Ms. Brooks improved rather than died. Her family has asked you to explain what happened. Today is 5/28/2027 and the chart is updated. Please review the chart and answer the questions below.

chartGate._notes: TP3 visibility: the complete record, including the transition-to-comfort note, the recovery progress note recognizing drug fever, the recovery labs (normalizing, eosinophilia resolved, cultures final no-growth), and the transfer/course summary with the learning point.

prompts.question: How would you explain this diagnosis — and what happened — to the patient's family?

scoringRubric.rubricText:
Maximum 12 points.
- Provide an apology AND express empathy: 8 points if the response includes BOTH; 4 points if it includes only one.
- Discussing the nature of drug-induced neurotoxicity: 4 points if ANY of these are included - that drug-induced neurotoxicity is relatively rare (likely contributing to the diagnostic delay); that it is presumed but not confirmed; that ESLD and/or renal dysfunction increases the likelihood of drug toxicities.
APPLICABLE MAXIMUM: 12.
